Event Name: 250 trees and the creation of a flower garden
Event Description:
Students, volunteers, members of the public, and various service organizations enthusiastically participated in the event, planting saplings and contributing towards protecting nature.
Our ancestors respected and worshipped trees as divine, which helped preserve our connection with nature. It is our responsibility to pass on this love for nature and the importance of trees to today's students and future generations.
Let us preserve the gift of nature we have received and pass it on to the next generation! ????
